html: <sherpa-node data-heading="Start" data-icon="play" data-x="40" data-y="40">A trigger starts the flow.</sherpa-node>
<sherpa-node data-heading="Step" data-icon="gear" data-x="320" data-y="40" data-current>One step does the work.</sherpa-node>
use: For one step of a flow on a `sherpa-layout-canvas`: a card the reader drags by its header, which reports each move and asks to be selected. The host writes `data-current` on the one it selects. For a card in the page flow, use `sherpa-container`.
